pages.title: New Animals
pages.text: This entry covers bison, leopard seals, armadillos, Bactrian camels, dromedary camels, and nine freshwater fish. They follow TFC climate, food, and processing rules.$(br2)For general predator, ramming, familiarity, breeding, and riding rules, see $(l:the_world/wild_animals)TFC Wild Animals$() and $(l:mechanics/animal_husbandry)TFC Animal Husbandry$().

pages.title: Pests
pages.text: Lemmings, mongooses, and jerboas appear as pests in cold, warm, or dry regions. Pets will hunt them, and they do not provide livestock products.$(br2)For testing, they can be summoned with spawn eggs or commands.

pages.title: Bison
pages.text: Bison spawn on open plains with $(l:the_world/climate#temperature)temperature$() from -10 to 15°C and $(l:the_world/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() from 160 to 420 mm. They are $(l:the_world/wild_animals#ramming_prey)ramming animals$() and are more likely to charge after being hurt. They drop raw bison, which can be heated, preserved, and processed like other TFC meats.

pages.title: Leopard Seal
pages.text: Leopard seals spawn on cold beaches, ice-sheet edges, and sea ice with $(l:the_world/climate#temperature)temperature$() at most -9°C and $(l:the_world/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() at least 105 mm. They are amphibious aquatic predators that can move in water and can be fed suitable seal food.

pages.title: Armadillo Behavior
pages.text: Armadillos spawn where $(l:the_world/climate#temperature)temperature$() is above 12°C and $(l:the_world/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() is between 100 and 400 mm.

pages.title: Armadillo Scutes
pages.text: Adults shed one scute every 30 hours. They flee players and awake land predators, roll up under threat, and take reduced damage while rolled. Spider eyes attract and breed them; scutes can be processed into flux powder with a quern or hammer.

pages.title: Bactrian Camel
pages.text: Bactrian camels spawn in cold deserts with $(l:the_world/climate#temperature)temperature$() at most -5°C and $(l:the_world/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() at most 100 mm. They are rideable, slower than horses but faster on sand and snow, and eat grains and fruits. Adults can be sheared for TFC wool, restoring the wool every 7 in-game days.

pages.title: Dromedary Camel
pages.text: Dromedary camels spawn in drier climates with $(l:the_world/climate#temperature)temperature$() at least -5°C and $(l:the_world/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() at most 100 mm. They are rideable, slower than horses but faster on sand, and immune to cactus damage; they eat grains and fruits. They cannot currently breed.

pages.title: New Freshwater Fish
pages.text: The nine fish below use TFC $(l:mechanics/fishing)fishing$() and fish-bucket mechanics, including decay, heating, and cooking.$(br2)They normally spawn from May through October according to river or lake temperature and groundwater. Each species has raw and cooked food, a fish bucket, and a spawn egg.

pages.title: Arctic Char
pages.text: Arctic char live in rivers or lakes at $(l:the_world/climate#temperature)temperature$() from -20 to -8°C and $(l:the_world/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() from 150 to 400 mm.

pages.title: Burbot
pages.text: Burbot live in rivers or lakes at $(l:the_world/climate#temperature)temperature$() from -16 to -9°C and $(l:the_world/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() below 350 mm.

pages.title: Muksun
pages.text: Muksun live in rivers or lakes at $(l:the_world/climate#temperature)temperature$() from -20 to -10°C and $(l:the_world/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() of at least 250 mm.

pages.title: Northern Pike
pages.text: Northern pike live in rivers or lakes at $(l:the_world/climate#temperature)temperature$() from -14 to -5°C and $(l:the_world/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() from 150 to 400 mm.

pages.title: Peacock Bass
pages.text: Peacock bass live in rivers or lakes at $(l:the_world/climate#temperature)temperature$() from 12 to 25°C and $(l:the_world/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() from 200 to 400 mm.

pages.title: Pacu
pages.text: Pacu live in rivers or lakes at $(l:the_world/climate#temperature)temperature$() from 20 to 35°C and $(l:the_world/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() above 200 mm.

pages.title: Red Piranha
pages.text: Red piranha live in rivers or lakes at $(l:the_world/climate#temperature)temperature$() from 22 to 35°C and $(l:the_world/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() above 300 mm.

pages.title: Spotted Gudgeon
pages.text: Spotted gudgeon live in rivers or lakes at $(l:the_world/climate#temperature)temperature$() from 6 to 24°C and $(l:the_world/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() below 250 mm.

pages.title: Tilapia
pages.text: Tilapia live in rivers or lakes at $(l:the_world/climate#temperature)temperature$() from 10 to 32°C and $(l:the_world/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() below 300 mm.

pages.title: Getting and Processing
pages.text: Freshwater fish can be caught or moved with fish buckets, and raw and cooked fish follow TFC preservation and heating rules. Bison, leopard seals, and armadillos use the normal meat-processing chain; armadillo scutes can become flux powder, and Bactrian camels can be sheared for wool.

pages.title: Spawn Settings
pages.text: Natural spawning for these animals can be adjusted independently in the configuration.
